newsitem.title: USA: Guidant gets FDA approval for catheter.
newsitem.headline: Guidant gets FDA approval for catheter.

text.p: Guidant Corp said Monday it has received U.S. Food and Drug Administration approval to market its ACS Tx2000 VP coronary dilatation catheter in the United States.
The catheter, manufactured by its Vascular Intervention Group, is an over-the-wire catheter with high-pressure capabilities, Guidant said. The catheter is used to open blocked arteries.

"This latest product approval completes the family of ACS Tx2000 over-the-wire catheters by offering balloon materials in both extended and high pressure ranges," said Ginger Howard, president of the Guidant Vascular Intervention Group.
The ACS Tx2000 VP catheter is available in both 15mm and 20mm sizes with proximal and distal markers.

Each year, nearly 750,000 people worldwide undergo a procedure that requires a balloon angioplasty catheter, Guidant said. During coronary angioplasty, a catheter equipped with a balloon is inserted into the blocked artery. When the balloon is inflated, it clears blockage.
